**Status: PASS**

Sidebar item "知识与规则" (Knowledge & Rules) with badge "6" was clicked within the prototype. After the auth overlay was dismissed, the Knowledge & Rules page loaded.

**Exact visible governance text:**
> "按事项搜索官方来源；自动检查不以人工审核为前置。"
> (Retrieve official sources by item; automatic checks do not prioritize manual review as a prerequisite.)

**Governance mechanism: Automatic — NOT manual (人工审核/发布生效).**
- The page explicitly states automatic checking is the mechanism, and manual review (人工审核) is NOT a prerequisite for publication (不以人工审核为前置).

**Page title:** 管理控制台 / 知识与规则

**Status: NOT_RUN**

- Viewport dimensions 1280×900, 1440×900, and 1940×1080 were not tested via browser controls.
- No screenshot URLs or actual before/after dimensions captured. Resizing is NOT possible via Figma prototype viewer controls alone.
